description: Search Spotify podcasts by keyword — the equivalent of the search box's 'Podcasts & Shows' tab (/search/{q}/podcastAndEpisodes). type picks the result scope: all (default, both podcast shows and episodes) | podcasts (shows only) | episodes (episodes only, the /search/{q}/episodes sub-page). Returns show cards (id, url, title, publisher, cover) and/or episode cards (id, url, title, parent show, date, duration, cover), loading internally via the app's own GraphQL (searchPodcasts/searchFullEpisodes) up to --limit per kind (max 100); partial=true when results run out. Runs in a browser context; no login needed. Music-domain tabs (songs/artists/albums/playlists) are out of scope. 中文：按关键词搜索 Spotify 播客节目与单集，等价于搜索框「播客和节目」tab。type 控制范围：all 节目+单集 / podcasts 只节目 / episodes 只单集。内部走应用自身 GraphQL 翻页。

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keyword(s), e.g. 'joe rogan'. Plain free text, no special syntax. 中文：搜索关键词，自由文本。

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Result scope: all (default — both podcast shows and episodes, the two sections of the 'Podcasts & Shows' tab) | podcasts (shows only, searchPodcasts) | episodes (episodes only, maps to the /search/{q}/episodes sub-page, searchFullEpisodes). 中文：结果范围。all 节目+单集 / podcasts 只节目 / episodes 只单集。

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max results per kind, 1-100, default 20. The command paginates internally with the app's GraphQL offset (page size 30); partial=true when a kind runs out before reaching limit. 中文：每类结果数上限 1-100，默认 20；内部 offset 翻页，耗尽标记 partial=true。
